content.value: Sarah works as a Web Developer for XYZ CORP. She is creating a Web site for her company. Sarah wants greater control over the appearance and presentation of Web pages. She wants the ability to precisely specify the display attributes and the appearance of elements on the Web pages.
A. Use the Database Design wizard.
B. Make two templates, one for the index page and the other for all other pages.
D. Make a template and use it to create each Web page.
